svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Measured hazard data from five upstreams, cached at the edge in Durable Objects, drawn as a per-province 3D scene — two Cloudflare Workers on one origin.
offline dataset — built once, not polled
TMD · ThaiWater · GISTDA · USGS / EMSC · radar
serves the R2 tile pyramid under /aoi/**
gdal / osmium, run by hand — never in the request path
tiles read straight from the bucket

One host, two Workers — siahra-web owns siahra-radar.co as a Custom Domain; siahra-api is bound to the route /api/*, which runs before the origin and claims it first. Same origin, no CORS, deployed separately.
Honest by construction — every layer declares a HazardLayerDescriptor, /api/v1/health reports each upstream's freshness, and a stale or dead source stays visible in the UI instead of disappearing.
In development — Vite serves the tiles from apps/etl/data/tiles instead of R2, and cron does not fire under wrangler dev, so every Durable Object schedules its own alarm.
